Ben/Samantha — quick follow-up from Cobalt Security. We reviewed the NDA — thank you — but per our vendor intake policy we require the completed vendor security questionnaire and evidence of SOC2 or equivalent controls before a live product demo with engineering can be scheduled. The specific gating items:
- Completed questionnaire (we will email the form in a separate thread)
- SOC 2 Type II or equivalent attestation (if available; if not, we accept an in-progress timeline)
- Network architecture diagram for any customer-facing endpoints

If those items aren't provided, we can't authorize a demo with engineers present. We can do an executive briefing (slides) without technical details sooner if that helps keep momentum.

Security Team | Cobalt Logistics
